summary: Tested Stock Restock Tool (admin dashboard) and Print Receipt feature. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: all flows verified end-to-end via Playwright and visual screenshots.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css @media print block does not include a `.print\:hidden` utility class for the buttons wrapper div — it relies on Tailwind JIT to generate it. This should work fine with Tailwind v3 JIT, but confirm Tailwind purge config includes Receipt.js. Visual confirmation from screenshot shows the print button is rendering correctly at screen.

Low-stock section on admin dashboard (stats query) and Products & Stock section use different queries (admin-stats vs products). After stock save, both queryClient.invalidateQueries calls are present — this is correct.
seed_data_creation: Stock of Anar Big was set to 50 during testing, then restored to 24 in final test step.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (Stock Restock Tool + Print Receipt) are fully working. Backend PATCH /api/admin/products/{id}/stock: returns {ok:true, stock:N}, 400 for negative, 404 for bad id, 401 for unauth/non-admin. Frontend: Products & Stock section shows all 8 products with correct color-coded badges (green>10, yellow 1-10), pencil icon opens inline input pre-filled with current stock, save updates badge immediately + invalidates queries, cancel/Escape closes without saving. Receipt page shows Print receipt button (data-testid=print-receipt-btn) with print:hidden on parent wrapper. All previously tested Phase 2 features still intact.
